earlier_scan.source_named: Opgenort (2014) Initial Grammatical Sketch of Tilung (field report) - not found online; Rai (2012) Nepalese Linguistics 27 was read in full and contains no stress statement

sources.citation: Nepalese Linguistics vols 28, 29, 31, 32, 33, 34 (Digital Himalaya, text layers) -- a full-text search for stress/accent Tilung
sources.note: Only census/vitality tables mention Tilung; no Tilung article.

sources.citation: Opgenort, Jean Robert. 2013 'Tilung language' page on opgenort.nl (Internet Archive copy 2013-11-27)
sources.note: Nothing linguistic; states the forthcoming sketch (fieldwork June 2011) 'discusses topics such as phonology, nominal morphology, verbal morphology, adverbs and syntax'. the Internet Archive's index confirms no PDF of the sketch was ever hosted on the site.

sources.citation: Rai, Vishnu S. 2012. A phonological study of Tilung: An endangered language of Nepal. Nepalese Linguistics 27: 143-150
sources.note: Nothing. Segmental inventory (stops incl. retroflex and breathy series, nasals, s, h, liquids, glides; vowels) and comparison with Chamling; no statement on stress, accent or tone (confirms the earlier scan).

sources.citation: Opgenort, Jean Robert. 2011. A note on Tilung and its position within Kiranti. Himalayan Linguistics 10(1): 253-271. DOI 10.5070/H910123576 (eScholarship open access)
sources.note: Nothing. Pre-fieldwork comparative study of ~140 second-hand words (Toba 2004, Rapacha VS 2065): phoneme/grapheme inventory (Diagram 1) and historical development of initials; no word for stress/accent/tone anywhere in the text.

sources.citation: Toba, Sueyoshi. 2004. Tilung: an endangered Kiranti language. Preliminary observations. Nepalese Linguistics 21: 142-147 (Digital Himalaya scan, image-only; pages read as images and scanned)
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 2 'Phonology' (pp. 143-144) lists consonants, vowels i e a o u, diphthongs ai oi ui, syllable structure C(C)V(C); no prosody/stress remark. Based on 80 words from LSN notes and Khambu's list.

sources.citation: Rai, Tara Mani. 2017. A sociolinguistic survey of Tilung: A Tibeto-Burman language. Report submitted to the Linguistic Survey of Nepal (LinSuN), Central Department of Linguistics, Tribhuvan University, Kathmandu (fieldwork by Tara Mani Rai and Omkareshor Shrestha). x + 110 pp.

sources.note: A Nepali-language phonemic inventory ('barna pahichan' = identification of sounds/letters, typically for orthography development); it may or may not address tone (Nepali 'tan'/'sur'); the English summary of the earlier NFDIN phonology (Rai 2012, NepLing 27) is silent on tone and stress.

tone.says: A Nepali-language phonemic inventory ('barna pahichan' = identification of sounds/letters, typically for orthography development); it may or may not address tone (Nepali 'tan'/'sur'); the English summary of the earlier NFDIN phonology (Rai 2012, NepLing 27) is silent on tone and stress.
